recommendation: Keep the no-change audit as-is. The current Security and Privacy module satisfies FHIR-14312; any future desire for more detailed FHIR document-Bundle-specific de-identification guidance should be raised as a new work-group decision.

That commit updated source/secpriv-module.html by adding the Narrative and Attachment caveat, expanding ids versus identifiers guidance, and discussing consistent id changes across a de-identified resource set.
additional_context: FHIR-10581 added the original de-identification H4 to the same module page and is already represented on the combined branch by an AutoFHIR no-change audit. The direct Zulip thread records Grahame asking that the section mention text narrative and documents, John asking for a CR, and Grahame replying GF#14312. The filed Jira description and implementation used Attachment plus resource-set/id consistency guidance rather than separate FHIR document-Bundle prose.
reconciliation: An empty no-change audit commit was published. The current source at source/secpriv-module.html explicitly links Narrative and Attachment as particularly difficult challenges, explains ids and external identifiers, describes consistency across resource sets, and frames de-identification by intended use, extraction scope, and release risk. The module page is linked from current module navigation, so this is active source rather than stale generated output.
